eyebrow: ServiceNow Flow Designer & Automation · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 9 · Flow Actions

code:
Create Record
- pick a table (Incident, Change, custom)
- map fields from data pills or static values
- always produces a NEW record
caption: Builds something that didn't exist before.

code:
Update Record
- targets an EXISTING record
- often the trigger record itself (auto data pill)
- or a record looked up earlier in the flow
caption: Changes something that's already there.

code:
Notification action
- fires an existing Notification record
- or sends a direct message
- reuses Course 3's admin-configured templates
caption: Flow Designer sits on top of Notifications, not around them.
